profile.name: Alex Manev
profile.tagline: A home for my web apps, experiments, and projects.

apps.title: Garden Planner
apps.description: Your one-stop veg and fruit garden planner: design beds row by row with companion checks, get sowing, planting and harvest dates for your location, and keep a pruning and care calendar for every fruit tree.

apps.title: Vintage Camera
apps.description: A film-look camera for your phone: squircle viewfinder, six film stocks, grain, light leaks and an orange date stamp burned into every shot. Photos stay on your device.

apps.title: Power Tariff Clock
apps.description: A 24-hour clock dashboard that shows the time and which electricity tariff zone you're in right now — peak, off-peak, shoulder or the free midday window — with rates and a countdown to the next change.

apps.title: Lo-Fi Beat Maker
apps.description: Plug in your headphones and make chill lo-fi beats: tap a drum grid, pick jazzy chords that always fit, jam on in-key pads, and add vinyl crackle, tape wobble and rain.

apps.title: Home Workout Ideas
apps.description: Pick a body part and the exact area you want to hit — upper chest, lats, inner biceps, quads, hamstrings — and get every exercise you can do with a barbell, dumbbells, an adjustable bench or bodyweight.

apps.title: Timber Cut Planner
apps.description: List the timber you have and the pieces you need — it works out which boards to cut for the least offcut, or which lengths to buy, and lets you tick off each cut as you go.

apps.title: Flight Stopovers
apps.description: Pick a departure and arrival city and see every city you could connect through — one or two stops — drawn as routes on a world map.

apps.title: Baby's First Year
apps.description: A week-by-week health and growth plan from birth to one year — feeding schedule and log, appointments, age-appropriate activities, growth charts and every milestone, kept on your device.

apps.title: Contraction Timer
apps.description: A calm, private timer for labour contractions — track length, spacing, and whether a pattern is holding. Everything stays on your device.

apps.title: Hello World
apps.description: A minimal example app to show how a subpage is wired up. Copy this folder to start a new one.
